## Reassurance and shame
- Reassurance: "the good thing is you don't need to wear flattering colors head to toe"; "without changing your wardrobe to the core".
- Could read as shaming: "too much makeup will definitely make you look older"; "you'll never look up to date which means you will look older in it". The shame is put on clothes, always shown on herself first.

## The age in speech
Ages said 5 times, all as ranges: "30 40 50 or older"; "should they stop at 40 50 60 maybe older". "older" 11 times and "younger" 7 times; "mature" recurs as the bad word ("this very mature impression").

## Visuals in words
Yes, each fix is narrated as she changes: "as you see here I swapped long top for men's shirt tucked it in the skirt"; "I paired loose sweater with legging and high riding boots".
